title: 第5章 上门退婚第6章 聘礼 三十两六十两才够
slug: 乱世荒年我每日一卦粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第5章上门退婚？
嘴上说着，张三坡却不舍得将兔子递回来。
这三斤的兔子，够他好好吃一顿了！
刚刚从江尘腰间拿回来的兔子，在他心中已经成他的所有物了，到了手，还怎么舍得还回去。
可江尘将柴刀下按，脖间冰冷的刺痛传来。
还有江尘那几欲杀人的眼神，让张三坡汗毛竖起。
这个之前哄两句就高兴掏钱的小弟，如今好似完全变了一个人！
张三坡再不敢犹豫，连忙将兔子举起：“拿去拿去！”
江尘顺手接过，将兔子重新挂在腰上。
等柴刀收回，张三坡终于松了口气。
可随即，心中却生出蓬勃怒气。
往日只要自己哭诉、再吹捧两句。
最多加一句不这样就是不讲义气，实在不行就搬出陈花。
江尘立马就会拍着胸脯把财物送上。
可今天江尘竟然一反常态，还反过来威胁他！
张三坡被吓得煞白的脸，转眼又被气的面色涨红。
指着江尘直跺脚，似是受了天大的委屈：“江尘，我算是看错你了！
亏我还拿你当兄弟，为了一只兔子跟我动刀？”
江尘收好兔子，睥睨看去：“吃吃喝喝你一分不掏，整日想着占便宜，哄我卖家里的口粮，现在跟我说兄弟义气？”
张三坡气势一弱：“我那是家里穷，我要是有钱，肯定天天带你吃香的喝辣的。”

“这样吧。”
江尘抓住张三坡的肩膀：“现在我家的口粮没了，把你家过冬的口粮分我一半，我就还认你这个兄弟。”
张三坡张口，嗫嚅半天却说不出话来。
他口粮本就不够，怎么可能再分出一半。
“滚！”
江尘将其推的踉跄几步，背着柴下山。
这种人他前世见得多了，嘴上永远是兄弟义气、朋友感情。
实则永远贪小便宜没够，离得越远越好。
真兄弟，又怎么会哄他卖了家中口粮？
呵呵
“不过……要是我晚点上山，这雪兔怕是要被张三坡捡去了。”
“人品不行，运气倒是不错。”
江尘嘴角微微上扬：“可惜啊，被我抢了先！
难怪卦签让午时之前来呢，也亏是这张三坡起得晚。”
不过，能午时上山打柴，在泼皮中已经算是勤劳的了。
江尘走到村口时，不少村民同样往回走。
虽是冬日，没什么农活。
百姓却也能找到些活计做，或是打柴，或是修补房屋，总归闲不住的。
江尘见到几个眼熟的村民，还主动打招呼：“陈大娘！”
“赵叔，打柴回来啊！”

几人听到声音，回头看了一眼，立刻往路边退了几步，一副避之不及的模样！
content_en:
Chapter 5: Coming to break off the engagement?
As he said this, Zhang Sanpo was reluctant to hand the rabbit back.
This three kilograms of rabbit is enough for him to have a good meal!
The rabbit he had just taken back from Jiang Chen's waist had already become his property in his heart. How could he be willing to give it back once he got it?
But Jiang Chen pressed the hatchet down, and a cold stinging pain came from his neck.
And Jiang Chen's murderous look made Zhang Sanpo's hair stand on end.
This little guy who was happy to pay after just a few words of coaxing seems to be a completely different person now!
Zhang Sanpo did not dare to hesitate anymore and quickly raised the rabbit: "Take it, take it!"
Jiang Chen took it and hung the rabbit on his waist again.
When the hatchet was withdrawn, Zhang Sanpo finally breathed a sigh of relief.
But then, anger arose in his heart.
In the past, I only had to cry and praise myself.
The most I can add is that if you don't do this, you are being disrespectful. If it doesn't work, just move out the old flowers.
Jiang Chen would immediately hand over the property with a pat on his chest.
But today Jiang Chen went out of his way and threatened him in return!
Zhang Sanpo's face turned pale with fright, and then turned red with anger.
He pointed at Jiang Chen and stamped his feet, as if he had been greatly wronged: "Jiang Chen, I must have misjudged you!
Why do you think I still treat you as a brother, so you go to the knife with me over a rabbit? "
Jiang Chen put away the rabbit and looked at it with a look of disdain: "You don't pay for anything for food and drink. You think about taking advantage all day long and coax me into selling the family's rations. Now you tell me about brotherly loyalty?"
Zhang Sanpo's momentum weakened: "My family is poor. If I were rich, I would definitely take you to eat and drink delicious food every day."
"So be it."
Jiang Chen grabbed Zhang Sanpo's shoulders: "Now that my family's rations are gone, give me half of your family's winter rations, and I will still recognize you as my brother."
Zhang Sanpo opened his mouth and murmured for a long time but could not speak.
His rations are not enough, how can he get another half.
"Get out!"
Jiang Chen pushed him staggering a few steps and carried the firewood down the mountain.
He had seen many people like this in his previous life, and he always talked about brotherly loyalty and friendship.
In fact, it is never enough to be greedy for petty advantages, and the farther away, the better.
How could a true brother coax him into selling his family's food rations?
Haha
"But... if I go up the mountain later, I'm afraid this snow rabbit will be picked up by Zhang Sanpo."
"My character is not good, but my luck is good."
The corner of Jiang Chen's mouth raised slightly: "What a pity, I was the first one to do so!
No wonder the fortune teller told him to come before noon. Unfortunately, this Sanpo got up late. "
However, being able to go up the mountain to collect firewood at noon is considered hard-working among the rogues.
When Jiang Chen walked to the entrance of the village, many villagers also walked back.
Although it is winter, there is not much farm work.
However, the common people can also find some work to do, such as collecting firewood or repairing houses, but they are always busy.
Jiang Chen saw a few familiar villagers and took the initiative to say hello: "Aunt Chen!"
"Uncle Zhao, come back from collecting firewood!"
Several people heard the sound, looked back, and immediately took a few steps back to the roadside, looking like they couldn't avoid it!
